text: dsh-chat-collapse 是面向 DSH Web 的浏览器界面插件，在聊天输入框工具行添加收缩按钮，并提供角落恢复球。点击按钮可隐藏输入框，或通过恢复球右键切换为隐藏整个对话区；点击恢复球或使用 Alt+H 可展开。插件通过页面样式控制显隐，并将收起状态、收缩目标和恢复球位置保存在浏览器 localStorage。适合希望减少输入框占用空间、查看更多对话内容的 DSH Web 用户。需要安装到 web profile 并重启 DSH Web；不需要 API key 或外部服务。

dsh-chat-collapse adds controls to collapse and restore the DSH Web composer. Right-click the floating ball to hide the composer or whole conversation; Alt+H toggles visibility. UI state is stored in localStorage. Install in the web profile and restart DSH Web; no key or external service is needed.
想把聊天输入框收起来，多留些空间看对话。
DSH 网页能不能一键隐藏输入区，再快速恢复？
I want to collapse the chat composer or conversation area to see more messages.
dsh-chat-collapse 的功能「收起与恢复聊天区」：点击输入框工具行的按钮可收起输入框，按 Alt+H 可切换收起状态；收起后点击角落恢复球即可展开。

给 DSH Web GUI 的聊天组件加一枚「一键收缩」
点一下把组件藏起来，角落浮出恢复球；点球即还原，球自己消失。

dsh-chat-collapse README · Introduction：
dsh-chat-collapse README · Introduction：> 纯浏览器侧插件，**零 DSH 源码改动**。不 patch 本体、不注入 bundle、不起宿主服务。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 它解决什么：小屏上输入框和工具条常驻，能看的对话就少了那么一截。
本插件在输入框工具行最右侧放一枚 **⌄** 按钮：点一下整条组件收起，纵向空间全给对话；
角落留一颗恢复球，随时点回来。

收起是 **CSS 隐藏，DOM 不卸载** —— 草稿、贴的图、光标位置全都留着，展开回来接着写。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 交互：| 动作 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 点输入框工具行最右侧的 **⌄** 按钮 | 目标组件收起（草稿 / 图片 / 光标位置全部保留） |
| 收起后 | 视口角落浮出 **恢复球**（对话气泡图标） |
| 点恢复球 | 组件放回来，球自己消失 |
| 右键恢复球 | 在「输入框 / 整个对话区」之间切换收缩目标，并弹一条轻提示 |
| `Alt+H` | 键盘切换收起 / 展开 |

状态（是否收起、收缩目标、悬浮球位置）写 `localStorage['dsh.chatCollapse.v1']`，刷新后保持。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 收缩目标：| target | 藏什么 | 靠什么定位 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `composer`（默认） | 只藏输入框那一条座位 | `[data-composer-seat]` |
| `chat` | 藏整个对话区（消息 + 输入框 + 会话头） | `[data-conversation-scroll]` 的父节点 |

显隐由 `<html>` 上的 `data-dsh-cc` / `data-dsh-cc-target` 两个属性 + CSS 选择器驱动 ——
**不给官方节点加类名**，React 重渲染抹不掉。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cx2002302-lang/dsh-chat-collapse
```

装完**重启一次 dsh web**（新 bundle 要进客户端启动图），再刷新页面：

```bash

dsh-chat-collapse README · 服务名按你自己的部署改；下面是 systemd 用户服务的写法：systemctl --user restart dsh-web.service
```

刷新后：输入框工具行最右侧即出现 ⌄ 按钮。

本地开发时也可以直接指向目录：bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-chat-collapse
```

dsh-chat-collapse README · 卸载：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-collapse
```

卸载时 `ctx.effect` 的回收函数会摘掉自己注入的 `<style>`、按钮、恢复球与 `<html>` 属性，
**不留残留**（`tests/unit-check.mjs` 里有对应断言）。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 依赖的官方钩子：| 钩子 | 出处 |
| --- | --- |
| `[data-composer-card]` | `ui-conversation/skeleton/InputBar.tsx` |
| `[data-composer-seat]` | `ui-conversation/skeleton/ConversationRoot.tsx` |
| `[data-conversation-scroll]` | 同上 |

三个都是源码里的**字面量属性**，不是 CSS-module 哈希类名，版本内稳定。
在 **dsh 0.1.2-rc.1** 上实测存在。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 隐私：- **无网络请求、无遥测、无宿主侧服务。**
- 唯一落盘的是 `localStorage['dsh.chatCollapse.v1']`（三个布尔 / 枚举值）。
- 宿主半侧 `lib/index.js` 是空 `apply()`，不注册任何服务、不读任何文件。
- 插件不接触会话内容，不读取草稿文本。

dsh-chat-collapse README · 目录：```
lib/index.js          宿主半侧：空 apply（只为把 dsh.client 声明登记进 web 名册）
lib/client.js         浏览器半侧：全部功能（__ModuleLoader__ bundle，无 JSX、无构建）
cordis.patch.yml      把本插件 insert 进 web profile 的插件名册
tests/unit-check.mjs  纯 Node 检查：断言真正生成的那张样式表（无需浏览器，17 条）

dsh-chat-collapse README · 1) 纯 Node，无浏览器依赖：node tests/unit-check.mjs

dsh-chat-collapse README · 2) 浏览器功能自测（headless Chrome）：google-chrome --headless=new --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=6000 \
  --dump-dom "file://$PWD/tests/smoke.html" | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|passed'
```

dsh-chat-collapse README · 改配置：默认值都在 `lib/client.js` 顶部的 `DEFAULTS`：`collapsed` / `target` / `anchor` / `ball`。

- `anchor: 'toolRow'`（默认）按钮进工具行；改成 `'corner'` 则贴输入框卡片右上角。
- `ball: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl'` 恢复球落点，默认右下。
  底边两档的 `bottom` = `BALL_INSET(20) + BALL_SIZE(44)/2` = **42px** —— 比基准抬高半个球高，
  避开收起后右下角本来就有的常驻控件；要再挪改这两个常量即可。

dsh-chat-collapse README · Introduction：

dsh-chat-collapse

One-click collapse for the DSH Web GUI chat component
Click once to hide it; a floating restore ball appears in the corner. Click the ball to bring it back — the ball disappears.

English | 中文
dsh-chat-collapse README · Introduction：

dsh-chat-collapse README · Introduction：> A browser-side plugin with **zero changes to the DSH codebase**. No patching the host,
> no bundle injection, no host-side service.

dsh-chat-collapse README · The problem it solves：On a small screen the composer and its toolbar are always there, and that eats a slice of
the conversation you can actually read. This plugin puts a **⌄** button at the right end of
the composer tool row: one click collapses the whole component and hands the vertical space
back to the transcript. A restore ball stays in the corner, ready to bring it back.

Hiding is **CSS-only — the DOM stays mounted** — so your draft, pasted images and caret
position all survive. Reopen it and keep typing.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Interactions：| Action | Result |
| --- | --- |
| Click the **⌄** button at the right end of the composer tool row | The target component collapses (draft / images / caret preserved) |
| After collapsing | A **restore ball** (chat-bubble icon) floats in the viewport corner |
| Click the restore ball | The component returns and the ball hides itself |
| Right-click the restore ball | Cycles the collapse target between “composer only” and “whole conversation area”, with a brief toast |
| `Alt+H` | Keyboard toggle for collapse / expand |

dsh-chat-collapse README · Interactions：State (collapsed or not, collapse target, ball position) lives in
`localStorage['dsh.chatCollapse.v1']` and survives a reload.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Collapse targets：| target | What gets hidden | Anchored by |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `composer` (default) | Only the composer seat | `[data-composer-seat]` |
| `chat` | The whole conversation area (transcript + composer + session header) | the parent of `[data-conversation-scroll]` |

Visibility is driven by two attributes on `<html>` (`data-dsh-cc` / `data-dsh-cc-target`)
plus CSS selectors — **no class names are added to official nodes**, so a React re-render
cannot wipe them.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:cx2002302-lang/dsh-chat-collapse
```

Then **restart `dsh web` once** (a new client bundle has to enter the boot graph) and
refresh the page:

```bash

dsh-chat-collapse README · Adjust the unit name to your deployment; this is the systemd user-service form：systemctl --user restart dsh-web.service
```

After the refresh the ⌄ button appears at the right end of the composer tool row.

For local development you can also point straight at a directory:bash
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-chat-collapse
```
section: Adjust the unit name to your deployment; this is the systemd user-service form

text:
dsh-chat-collapse README · Uninstall：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-chat-collapse
```

On unload the `ctx.effect` disposer removes the injected `<style>`, the button, the restore
ball and the `<html>` attributes — **no residue** (asserted in `tests/unit-check.mjs`).

dsh-chat-collapse README · Official hooks it relies on：| Hook | Source |
| --- | --- |
| `[data-composer-card]` | `ui-conversation/skeleton/InputBar.tsx` |
| `[data-composer-seat]` | `ui-conversation/skeleton/ConversationRoot.tsx` |
| `[data-conversation-scroll]` | same file |

All three are **literal attributes in the source**, not CSS-module hashed class names, so
they are stable within a version. Verified present on **dsh 0.1.2-rc.1**.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Privacy：- **No network requests, no telemetry, no host-side service.**
- The only thing persisted is `localStorage['dsh.chatCollapse.v1']` (three boolean / enum values).
- The host half `lib/index.js` is an empty `apply()` — it registers no service and reads no file.
- The plugin never touches conversation content and never reads draft text.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Layout：```
lib/index.js          Host half: empty apply (only registers the dsh.client declaration)
lib/client.js         Browser half: everything (__ModuleLoader__ bundle, no JSX, no build step)
cordis.patch.yml      Inserts this plugin into the web profile's plugin roster
tests/unit-check.mjs  Pure-Node check: asserts the stylesheet it actually generates (17 cases, no browser)
dsh-chat-collapse README · Tests：```bash
dsh-chat-collapse README · 1) Pure Node, no browser dependency：node tests/unit-check.mjs

dsh-chat-collapse README · 2) Browser functional test (headless Chrome)：google-chrome --headless=new --no-sandbox --virtual-time-budget=6000 \
  --dump-dom "file://$PWD/tests/smoke.html" | grep -E 'PASS|FAIL|passed'
```

dsh-chat-collapse README · Configuration：Defaults live in `DEFAULTS` at the top of `lib/client.js`: `collapsed` / `target` /
`anchor` / `ball`.

dsh-chat-collapse README · Configuration：- `anchor: 'toolRow'` (default) puts the button in the tool row; `'corner'` pins it to the
  composer card's top-right corner instead.
- `ball: 'br' | 'bl' | 'tr' | 'tl'` sets the restore ball's corner; default is bottom-right.
  The `bottom` of the two bottom variants is `BALL_INSET(20) + BALL_SIZE(44)/2` = **42px** —
  half the ball's height above the baseline, clearing whatever already sits in that corner
  once the composer is hidden. Move it by editing those two constants.
